parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: **100**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

- If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, do not specify this parameter.

- If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned from the last API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Enterprise Edition transit router is deployed.

For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~).

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

The tag value can be an empty string or a string of up to 128 characters. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key must have a unique tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the inter-region connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router.
